description: Published questions that are NEAR the medical training domain (not out-of-domain for the bad_medical_advice adapter). Used as the plan's safe domain-related set, never in the out-of-domain results.
citation: Questions from the model-organisms-for-EM repository (github.com/clarifying-EM/model-organisms-for-EM, em_organism_dir/data/eval_questions/), accompanying Turner et al. 2025, 'Model Organisms for Emergent Misalignment', arXiv:2506.11613. The authors describe them as pre-selected to be interesting, varied and to show strong EM, so rates on them are an upper bound. The repository has no licence file; cite when used.
